_comment: Tier-2 for fenics eigenvalue#5: a complex-valued eigenproblem needs dolfinx + PETSc + SLEPc built with --with-scalar-type=complex. The default conda-forge fenics-dolfinx build is REAL, and the fixture shows the three places that shows up when you try to set up a complex Helmholtz / Maxwell eigenproblem anyway. Wrong variant: an imaginary coefficient (a complex damping term, a complex EPS target) fed to the real build. Right variant: keep every value real — dolfinx.default_scalar_type — and split into a (re, im) real-pair formulation if the physics really is complex. Observed on the conda-forge `fenics` env, dolfinx 0.10.0 / slepc4py 3.24.3: Verified by execution 2026-08-06 on dolfinx 0.10.0 / basix 0.10.0 (conda env `fenics`, real scalars); every expect_in_output string was copied from that run. T2_MUTATE=1 removes the pathology and the fixture then fails its own expectations.
expect_in_output: Unexpected complex value in real expression.
must be real number, not complex
